nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What was the main objective of the study on climate change discourse in a fishing community in Central Philippines?
nodes.answer: The main objective was to contextualize how local communities' traditional ecological knowledge (TEK) related to climate, fisheries, and taboos can strengthen freshwater fisheries management and biodiversity conservation.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Indigenous knowledge in adaptation_qna_001
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What factors contribute to the evolution of Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)?
nodes.answer: TEK evolves through social experiences and adaptive processes over centuries of ecological adaptation by its knowledge holders to their respective environments.

nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How can local food production in the Arctic be enhanced?
nodes.answer: By increasing local capacity to produce food that meets local demand and merging traditional practices with innovative approaches to food security.
